title: What Safety Equipment Must a Tour Boat in Portugal Carry?
description: Life jackets for all on board, a lifebuoy, flares, first aid, an extinguisher, a pump and an anchor. Boats sailing further out add a radio and a liferaft.
heroAlt: Orange lifebuoy on a stern rail and a life jacket on a grey seat at Marina do Funchal
keywords: what safety equipment must a tour boat in Portugal carry
do tour boats need a liferaft Portugal

In sharp focus: an orange ring lifebuoy with a neatly coiled white line hangs on the stainless steel stern rail, and a bright orange adult life jacket lies folded on a grey cushioned seat just behind it. The boat's folding boarding ladder is raised at the stern. Calm green water in the marina, other small boats and pontoons soft in the background, gentle low sun from the east. No people, no text, no logos, realistic photograph, true colours.
